description: The peer starts again at FSN 0 after we received FSN 0 and 1: its TX UWE fails Test 1, the D_PDU is neither delivered nor acknowledged, and this node runs a FULL RESET as initiator; after the FULL RESET ACK the peer's FSN 0 is in sync and delivered.
note: Link setup as dts-arq/rx-data-acked (Called node). At 61000 the peer's burst holds two DATA-ONLY (type 9), FSN 0 (C_PDU START and END, TX WIN LWE set) with 'ping' and FSN 1 (TX WIN UWE set) with 'pong', 3 blocks, EOTs 30 and 20, so the predicted end is 71000. Both pass Tests 1 to 3 at the initial edges (C-0786: Equation 2 at start-up accepts 32768 forward to 0) and are delivered; RX LWE 2, RX UWE 1 (C-0776, C-0778). The ACK-ONLY with RX LWE 2 goes at 83000. At 96000 the peer, which has lost its ARQ state, sends a DATA-ONLY with FSN 0, TX WIN UWE and LWE set, 'boot'. Test 1 (C-0794): its TX UWE 0 must lie on the arc from RX UWE 1 forward to RX LWE + 32767 = 32769, and it does not (forward distance 65535). The peers are out of synchronisation (C-0802), so nothing in the D_PDU is used: no delivery and no acknowledgement (C-1170). This node starts a FULL RESET (C-0791, C-0792): a FULL RESET CMD (type 12 in the 16-bit family, C-0730) with FULL RESET CMD 1, RESET FRAME ID 0, the first of this connection's sequence (C-0806, C-1173), NEW RECEIVE LWE 0 and both window flags 0 (C-0805 to C-0809), 15 bytes, one block, EOT 10, sent at 151000 (contention 45000 after the predicted end 106000). When that transmission ends dts.reset_wait/0.0.1.3 runs for dts.ack_wait_ms, 60000 (C-0255, C-1172). At 161000 the peer's FULL RESET ACK (RESET ACK 1, every other field 0, C-0816 to C-0818) ends the exchange: dts.reset_wait stops, the window edges go back to the initial values and the receive buffers are flushed (C-0822, C-0824, C-0825). Nothing is queued, so the burst end at 162000 starts nothing. At 171000 the peer sends FSN 0 'boot' again; at the initial edges it is in sync, so it is delivered and owes an acknowledgement; the ACK-ONLY with RX LWE 1 goes at 217000. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500): 10, 20, 30 for 1, 2, 3 blocks to go (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133), so a DATA-ONLY is 19 bytes plus its segment, an ACK-ONLY 15 bytes plus its bitmap and a RESET/WIN-RESYNC (type 12) 15 bytes. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4, 15, 12, 11, 10, 1, 12: contention waits 45000, 12000, 45000, 36000, 33000, 30000, 3000, 36000 ms (K-0080). Fill (C-1154): every transmission leaves too few bytes for an ACK-ONLY copy or a PADDING D_PDU, or none, so it is zero filled. The SIS soft link times are unset, so they are derived: sis.soft_link_idle and sis.soft_link_min_hold (called node only) three answer waits, sis.soft_link_max six; none falls due within the run, and the idle wait stops while an ARQ U_PDU is outstanding (A-0320, A-0321, A-0326).
